scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ptw/shared && concurrently -n api,web,worker,shared -c blue,green,magenta,gray "npm run dev -w @ptw/api" "npm run dev -w @ptw/web" "npm run dev:worker -w @ptw/api" "npm run dev -w @ptw/shared"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ptw/shared && npm run build -w @ptw/api && npm run build -w @ptw/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ptw/shared && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
